name: modern20
description: Tooling for the Modern20 Foundry system. The system itself ships as plain ES modules and needs no build step; this manifest exists so the checks, the linters and the type checker are one command rather than nine.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff check tools || echo "ruff is not installed (pip install ruff) — skipping the Python lint"
scripts.check: npm run check:python && npm run check:node
scripts.check:python: python3 tools/check_private.py && python3 tools/check_globals.py && python3 tools/check_app_props.py && python3 tools/check_lang.py && python3 tools/check_config.py && python3 tools/check_shadowing.py && python3 tools/check_packs.py && python3 tools/check_coverage.py && python3 tools/check_rules_links.py && python3 tools/check_art.py && python3 tools/check_release.py
scripts.check:node: node tools/check_models.mjs && node tools/check_templates.mjs && node tools/check_species.mjs && node tools/check_classes.mjs && node tools/check_casting.mjs && node tools/check_combat.mjs && node tools/check_creatures.mjs && node tools/check_objects.mjs && node tools/check_rules.mjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check
